meta.title: How green is your capital? The 3-30-300 rule in the 27 EU capitals
meta.description: Three trees in view from every home, 30% tree canopy around it and a park within a 300 m walk: see how the 27 EU capitals measure up, building by building.

intro.label: The {capitals, number} EU capitals
intro.title: How green is your capital?
intro.lead: The 3-30-300 rule asks for three trees in view from every home, {canopy, number, percent} tree canopy around it and a park within a {distance, number, ::unit/meter} walk. We checked it for every home in the {capitals, number} EU capitals.

home.click: Click a capital on the map, or a row in the ranking
home.tap: Tap a capital on the map, or a row in the ranking

overview.click: Click anywhere on the map to zoom in on a street
overview.tap: Tap anywhere on the map to zoom in on a street

street.click: Click a building to see why it scores as it does
street.tap: Tap a building to see why it scores as it does

building.click: Switch rules with 3 · 30 · 300, or click a facade to see the trees it sees
building.tap: Switch rules with 3 · 30 · 300, or tap a facade to see the trees it sees

facade.click: Click the facade again to see the whole building
facade.tap: Tap the facade again to see the whole building

explore.click: Click another building to compare it, or press Esc to go back to the street
explore.tap: Tap another building to compare it
